items.source: Apply the filter to the given auto-configuration class candidates.
items.translation: 对给定的自动配置类候选项应用过滤器。

items.source: An AutoConfigurationImportFilter may implement any of the following Aware interfaces, and their respective methods will be called prior to match(String[], AutoConfigurationMetadata):
items.translation: `AutoConfigurationImportFilter` 接口可能实现以下任一 `Aware` 接口，其相应方法将在调用 `match(String[], AutoConfigurationMetadata)` 之前被调用：

items.source: autoConfigurationClasses - the auto-configuration classes being considered. This array may contain null elements. Implementations should not change the values in this array.
items.translation: `autoConfigurationClasses` - 正在考虑的自动配置类。此数组可能包含 `null` 元素。实现不应更改此数组中的值。

items.source: a boolean array indicating which of the auto-configuration classes should be imported. The returned array must be the same size as the incoming autoConfigurationClasses parameter. Entries containing false will not be imported.
items.translation: 一个布尔数组，指示应导入哪些自动配置类。返回的数组大小必须与传入的 `autoConfigurationClasses` 参数相同。包含 `false` 的条目将不会被导入。

items.source: autoConfigurationMetadata - access to the meta-data generated by the auto-configure annotation processor
items.translation: autoConfigurationMetadata - 访问由 auto-configure 注解处理器生成的元数据。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
